text: 我曾经吃过一块很好吃的糖，那是还在我懵懂的儿时。
en: I once ate a very delicious sweet, back when I was still in my ignorant childhood.

text: 我一直念念不忘这个味道，可我就吃过那一次，甚至我都不记得这块糖是否我真实的吃过。
en: I have never forgotten this taste, yet I only ate it that one time, and I do not even remember whether I truly ate that sweet.

text: 我上初中的时候就离开家了，寄住在姑姑家，那时候我才十三岁，我第一次强烈的感受到思乡之苦。
en: When I was in junior secondary school I left home and stayed with my aunt; I was only thirteen then, and it was the first time I felt the pain of homesickness so strongly.

text: 那时候我贴着贴画的文具盒里总会躺着那支妈妈给我买的钢笔，上课的时候我总会莫名的想起父母的模样，每当我特别想家的时候，我就会偷偷塞进嘴里一块糖，甜丝丝的带着苦味儿。
en: Back then, in my pencil case covered with stickers there always lay the fountain pen my mother bought me; during lessons I would inexplicably think of my parents' faces, and whenever I missed home terribly, I would secretly pop a sweet into my mouth, sweet with a faint bitter edge.

text: 上高中的时候，情窦初开，我喜欢上了一位算不得特别漂亮的女孩子。
en: When I was at senior secondary school, love first stirred in me, and I took a liking to a girl who could not be called especially pretty.

text: 那时候我特别期盼在校园里碰到她，我在食堂的某个角落，偷偷观望过她，我喜欢看她蹙眉的样子，喜欢看她撩拨头发的样子，更喜欢看她走路的样子。
en: Back then I especially hoped to run into her on campus; in some corner of the canteen I secretly watched her. I liked watching the way she knitted her brows, liked watching the way she flicked her hair, and even more liked watching the way she walked.

text: 那时候我感觉我吃到了小时候的那块糖。
en: Back then I felt I had tasted that sweet from my childhood.

text: 可惜，那块糖还没等我咽下喉咙，就消失的无影无踪。
en: Pity, that sweet vanished without a trace before I could even swallow it down my throat.

text: 当我进入大学的时候，那感觉像吃了一块薄荷糖，凉丝丝的沁人心脾，很安逸，安逸的让我感到恐慌。
en: When I entered university, it felt like eating a mint sweet, cool and refreshing to the heart, very peaceful, so peaceful it filled me with panic.

text: 我环顾四周，好像每个人都很安逸这份安逸，我偷偷的打起了背囊，报名参军，去了远离他乡的他乡。
en: I looked around; everyone seemed content with this peace, so I quietly packed my rucksack, signed up to join the army, and went to a faraway land beyond my homeland.

text: 在部队我想家，不像个男人一样的想家，我会哭，我懦弱到想家想到流泪，只是我只在夜晚蒙起被子的时候才会咬着被角不发出一点声响的流泪。
en: In the army I missed home, missing it in a way unbecoming of a man; I would cry, so weak that thoughts of home brought me to tears, and only at night, when I pulled the covers over my head, would I bite the corner of the quilt and weep soundlessly.

text: 就好比十三岁时吃的那颗五彩斑斓的糖纸下略带苦涩的糖。
en: It was like the slightly bitter sweet beneath the colourful sweet-wrapper I ate at thirteen.

text: 糖纸是我白天的坚强和伪装，糖心是我的柔软和思乡。
en: The wrapper was my daytime strength and disguise; the sweet's centre was my tenderness and homesickness.

text: 你看到的是糖纸，尝不到的是我的苦涩和悲伤。
en: What you see is the wrapper; what you cannot taste is my bitterness and sorrow.

text: 我退伍后谈过一个女朋友，我以为那是我吃到的世上最甜蜜的一块糖。
en: After I left the army I had a girlfriend; I thought she was the sweetest sweet I had ever tasted in this world.

text: 这块糖粘稠的让我失去了方向，我为她痴为她狂为她哐哐撞大墙。
en: This sweet was so sticky it made me lose my bearings; I was besotted with her, crazed for her, slamming myself against the wall again and again for her.

text: 我以为我尝到了我最想吃的那块糖，最后我还是失去了她，或者说她失去了我。
en: I thought I had tasted the sweet I most wanted to eat, but in the end I still lost her, or rather, she lost me.

text: 失恋是件很痛苦的事儿，我尝试过很多种方式摆脱她的身影，说是逃避也好，不敢面对也罢。
en: Heartbreak is a very painful thing; I tried all sorts of ways to shake off her image. Call it running away if you like, or not daring to face it.

text: 我试过喝的烂醉如泥，也试过抽烟到天亮，无济于事，她的身影如鬼魅般如影随形。
en: I tried drinking myself into a stupor, and tried smoking till dawn; it was no use, her image followed me like a ghost, clinging to me like a shadow.

text: 白天，我打起精神，一如正常的我，和同事谈笑风生，和工作玩命死磕，任何人都看不出我的异样。
en: By day I pulled myself together, just as the normal me, joking and laughing freely with colleagues, fighting tooth and nail with my work; no one could see anything amiss with me.

text: 晚上回到家后，环顾四周，总会有一种莫名的气氛压抑着我，我的这件衬衫她穿过，我的这瓶洗发水她用过，窗台上还残留着她梳落的长发，抽屉里还躺着她的卸妆棉。
en: At night, back home, looking around, there was always an inexplicable atmosphere bearing down on me: this shirt of mine she had worn, this bottle of shampoo she had used, on the windowsill still remained the long hairs she had combed loose, and in the drawer still lay her make-up remover pads.

text: 一切恍如昨日，我打开昨日喝剩的牛栏山，酒精刺激的我头晕目眩，我昏昏沉沉睡去，第二天醒来，塞进嘴里一块醒酒糖，我照了照镜子，满眼密布血丝，“昨日的悲伤就留在昨日吧。
en: Everything felt like yesterday; I opened the Niulanshan left over from yesterday's drinking, the alcohol making me dizzy and light-headed, and I fell into a heavy sleep. The next day when I woke, I popped a hangover sweet into my mouth, looked in the mirror, my eyes threaded with blood vessels: 'Let yesterday's sorrow stay in yesterday.'

text: ”我嚼着那块苦涩的醒酒糖挑着眉毛这样想。
en: ” I chewed that bitter hangover sweet and, raising my eyebrows, thought to myself thus.

text: 最后，我用了两年的时光终于走出了泥淖，走出了彷徨，只是…
en: At last, after two years I finally walked out of the mire, walked out of my hesitation, only…

text: 只是我是男人，男人也是人。
en: Only, I am a man, and a man is a person too.

text: 我只是表现的很坚强。
en: I merely put on a show of being very strong.

text: 我现在还是喜欢嚼一块糖，我不再刻意追求它究竟是不是我念念不忘的那块糖。
en: I still like to chew a sweet now; I no longer deliberately pursue whether it is in fact that sweet I never forgot.

text: 生活嘛，无非你死我亡。
en: Life, after all, is nothing but you dead or me dead.

text: 男人嘛，总要有一副铠甲来防御自己的懦弱和受伤。
en: A man, well, must always have a suit of armour to defend against his own weakness and hurt.

text: 当夜晚来临的时候，这副铠甲自行脱落，我赤裸的站在另一个自己的面前，依然会毫无顾忌的哭喊，毫无顾忌的心伤。
en: When night falls, this armour falls away of its own accord; I stand naked before another self, still able to cry out without restraint, to grieve without restraint.

text: 我终于还是找到了我最想吃的那块糖。
en: In the end I still found that sweet I most wanted to eat.

text: 现在的我依然会哭，会笑，会发脾气，会说脏话，会看黄片，会喝酒抽烟，有吹牛逼的时候，也有害怕到浑身颤栗的时候。
en: The me of now still cries, still laughs, loses my temper, swears, watches porn, drinks and smokes, has moments of boasting, and also moments of being so frightened I tremble all over.

text: 但当我吃起那块糖，我便拥有了敢于抗衡一切的力量。
en: But when I eat that sweet, I possess the strength to stand against everything.

text: 这块糖，我把它叫做——梦想。
en: This sweet, I call it — dream.

text: 前段时间我和先生及其基友们一起吃饭，
en: Some time ago I had a meal with my husband and his bunch of bros,

text: 谈到女生这个话题，基友神秘一笑，
en: Speaking of the topic of girls, the bros gave a mysterious smile,

text: 说他们自有一个女生打分标准，
en: saying they had their own scoring standard for girls,

text: 分别为：
en: namely:

text: 女活白富美，音智胸腰腿。
en: Female, alive, fair-rich-beautiful; voice, intellect, chest-waist-legs.

text: 详解就是：
en: The detailed explanation is:

text: 女的，活的，白富美，
en: Female, alive, fair-rich-beautiful,

text: 声音，智商，胸腰腿。
en: Voice, intellect, chest, waist, legs.

text: 然后他对自己近期的相亲对象按这个标准进行了综合打分，
en: Then he gave his recent matchmaking prospects a comprehensive score according to this standard,

text: 认为7分以上的妹纸才值得继续交往。
en: believing only girls scoring above 7 were worth continuing to see.

text: 我问，那我能得几分呢？
en: I asked, then how many points could I get?

text: 我先生抢答，2分，女+活～
en: My husband jumped in to answer: 2 points, female + alive~

text: 回家抱着键盘哭着要改成10分，too late boy....
en: Going home, I cried hugging the keyboard, demanding it be changed to 10 points, too late boy....

text: 我再问，那哪几项最重要呢？
en: I asked again, then which few items were most important?

text: 他们眼中闪着星光异口同声地回答：
en: Their eyes glinting like starlight, they answered in unison:

text: 白美胸腰腿～～～
en: Fair, beautiful, chest, waist, legs~~~

text: 表面上，什么都不怕。
en: On the surface, afraid of nothing.

text: 实际上，什么都害怕。
en: In reality, afraid of everything.

text: 表面上，什么都不在乎。
en: On the surface, caring about nothing.

text: 实际上，什么都记在心。
en: In reality, keeping everything in mind.

text: 表面上，阳光积极向上。
en: On the surface, sunny, positive and upward.

text: 实际上，能懒肯定要懒。
en: In reality, if one can be lazy, one surely will be lazy.

text: 有责任的时候，会有压力，不像外表表现的那样风轻云淡。
en: When there is responsibility, there is pressure; not as carefree as the exterior suggests.

text: 无所事事的时候，会有压力，总感觉到焦虑。
en: When there is nothing to do, there is pressure; one always feels anxious.

text: 游戏是生活中的重要乐趣，主要用来排遣压力。
en: Games are an important pleasure in life, mainly used to dispel pressure.

text: 看到漂亮女孩会忍不住多看几眼，但也就仅限于此而已。
en: Seeing a pretty girl, one cannot help but take a few extra looks, but it goes no further than that.

text: 看到帅气的男的也会忍不住多看几眼，会想自己能不能变成那样。
en: Seeing a handsome man, one also cannot help but take a few extra looks, and wonders whether one could become like that.

text: 总想着自己的未来，总觉得事事都要做。
en: Always thinking about one's own future, always feeling everything must be done.

text: 感觉身边的姑娘天天晒日常有点傻，但是不会明说，有些还会点赞。
en: Feels the girls around one who post daily updates are a bit silly, but will not say so openly; some even give them a like.

text: 回女生的信息一定是思考再三，回男生的基本不过脑子。
en: Replies to girls' messages are always thought over and over; replies to boys' are basically without a second thought.

text: 看重回报，非常看重，不管任何事，可以不等比，但是必须要有回报，没有回报就没有未来。
en: One values returns, values them greatly; whatever the matter, the ratio need not be equal, but there must be a return — without a return there is no future.

text: 关于化妆打扮一窍不通，但是性知识基本都了解。
en: Knows nothing whatsoever about make-up and dressing up, but basically understands sexual knowledge.

text: 很开心有女生愿意约自己，但是会紧张。
en: Very happy when a girl is willing to ask one out, but gets nervous.

text: 这是我的一些感受。
en: These are some of my feelings.

text: 不能说阅男无数，但据我这二十多年的接触和观察来看，有这么几点是男人的共性。
en: I cannot claim to have met countless men, but from my twenty-odd years of contact and observation, there are a few points that are common to men.

text: 喜欢长得漂亮的。
en: Like those who are good-looking.

text: 在男人眼里，好看排第一，这决定他们愿不愿意追你，性格，能力等是加分项。
en: In a man's eyes, good looks come first; this decides whether they are willing to chase you. Personality, ability and so on are bonus points.

text: 2. 怕麻烦，毫不夸张地讲，所有男人都很怕麻烦，所以为什么你看电视剧最多的是吵架时女生喋喋不休，男生沉默寡言，是他们不会反驳吗？
en: 2. Afraid of bother. To put it without exaggeration, all men dread bother, so why is it that in TV dramas you most often see girls prattling on during arguments while boys stay silent — is it that they cannot retort?

text: 还是他们真的被你怼到无话可说？
en: Or have they truly been talked down by you until they have nothing to say?

text: 其实都不是，他们只是懒得计较，觉得麻烦，因为沉默能让争吵快点收场。
en: Actually neither; they simply cannot be bothered to argue, finding it troublesome, because silence lets the quarrel end sooner.

text: 还有一个重要的体现就在追你之前和在一起之后，追你之前费劲心思，这确实是喜欢你的表现，但你们成为男女朋友后，随着时间的推移和感情的稳定，你也许会觉得他没有以前那么上心了，对你的情绪和需求也逐渐反应迟钝，其实他们可能并没有变心，只是回到了最原本的样子，而你错把追你时候的他当成真实状态的他。
en: There is another important manifestation, before chasing you and after being together: before chasing you he exhausts his thoughts, which truly is a sign he likes you. But after you become boyfriend and girlfriend, as time passes and feelings stabilise, you may feel he is not as attentive as before, and grows slowly slow to respond to your emotions and needs. Actually they may not have changed heart at all; they have merely returned to their most original selves, while you mistook the him-while-chasing-you for the real him.

text: 3. 像小孩子。
en: 3. Like a small child.

text: 一个男人不管在外面多么厉害多么坚强甚至于多么冷漠，但其实内心富有童趣，当他完全卸下防备的时候，完全就是一个大孩子的模样，当你抬起头看见这一幕，会觉得那样的他真的很可爱。
en: No matter how capable, how strong, even how cold a man is outside, inside he is rich in childlike fun; when he fully lets down his guard, he is completely the picture of a big child. When you look up and see this scene, you will find that version of him truly adorable.

text: 所以有些时候，女人存在的意义就是能给男人一个温暖的怀抱，让他们暂时地做回小孩。
en: So at times, the meaning of a woman's existence is to give a man a warm embrace, letting them temporarily be children again.

text: 4. 最后一点，也许有些残忍，但却真实。
en: 4. The last point, perhaps a little cruel, but true.

text: 曾经我也是恋爱脑（也许现在还是），在我没想清楚这一点之前，就曾经闹过很多次矛盾。
en: There was a time I too was a lovestruck fool (perhaps still am), and before I thought this through, I had many a conflict.

text: 那这一点是什么呢？
en: So what is this point?

text: 其实，在男人的世界里，女人的重要性or 位置也许只有30％。
en: Actually, in a man's world, a woman's importance, or position, may be only 30 per cent.

text: 其余的时间，精力他们想留给任何让他觉得有趣的事，可以是打游戏看直播，可以是睡觉也可以是看书开车等等等等。
en: The remaining time and energy they want to keep for anything that feels interesting to them — it could be playing games or watching livestreams, could be sleeping, or reading, driving, and so on and so forth.

text: 女人的存在只是锦上添花，并不是雪中送炭。
en: A woman's existence is merely icing on the cake, not a timely help.

text: 所以作为女性，千万不要用自己的思维和视角去要求男人，只要你觉得他心里有你，那就快乐和平地生活下去吧~
en: So as women, never use your own way of thinking and perspective to demand things of men; as long as you feel he has you in his heart, then live on happily and peacefully~

text: 以上四点，我相信大多数男人都有同感。
en: These four points above, I believe most men would echo.

text: 想到再更~
en: I'll update again when I think of more~
